AboutMe.title: About me
AboutMe.content:
I am a Full Stack Developer passionate about technology and driven to build smart, scalable solutions that solve real-world problems. I have hands-on experience across the entire software development lifecycle, working on challenging projects ranging from web applications to published browser extensions.

My tech stack includes **React**, **Next.js**, **Angular**, **TypeScript**, **Node.js**, **NestJS**, **Spring Boot**, **PostgreSQL**, **Docker**, and **AWS**, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and best practices. I've also served as a Tech Lead, guiding volunteer squads, defining architectures, conducting code reviews, and ensuring high-quality deliveries. Additionally, I actively contribute to open-source initiatives and develop side projects such as browser extensions and engagement tools.

streaminginteractions.title: Streaming Interactions
streaminginteractions.description:
Browser extension published on the Chrome Web Store that adds a floating sidebar to streaming sites like Netflix, Disney+, Crunchyroll, and others, allowing users to read, comment, and reply to other comments about the episode or movie they are watching in real time.
Stacks: React, Typescript, Zustand.

eplay.title: eplay
eplay.description: Educational project for a game store, with features to add and remove items from the cart and covering the entire shopping journey. Developed using React and Redux for global state management.
